title: Anima vs. Patchs: patient triage and online consultations for GP practices
summary: Compare Anima and Patchs for NHS GP patient triage, online consultations, messaging and booking, with FAQs on AI features and switching.
body_markdown:
## What is a total triage system?


Patient triage software helps a GP practice collect requests, understand the information provided and organise the next action. It brings clinical and administrative work into a process staff can review and manage. Staff can see who is handling each request, decide the next step and keep the patient informed.


Anima, Accurx, eConsult and Patchs help practices gather and manage patient requests. Your team needs to see what needs attention, who is handling it and what the patient needs next. Here’s how Anima and Patchs support that work.


## Comparing Anima and Patchs


Patchs offers online consultation tools and optional AI modules for urgency, signposting and workflow support. Its documentation describes AI Care Navigator as a way to combine and tailor those modules. When comparing a Patchs alternative, distinguish the core service from optional capabilities and confirm the configuration your practice would receive.

## FAQs


### What should you check when comparing AI triage features?


Ask what the software flags, recommends or does automatically, and which decisions stay with staff. Use representative requests to examine the information shown to the team and how a recommendation can be reviewed or corrected. Confirm how local pathways and practice rules are configured.


### Are all Patchs AI features part of the standard service?


Patchs describes its AI functionality as optional. Ask which modules are included in your quote, how they are enabled and what configuration or training they require. Apply the same check to the Anima proposal so that the comparison reflects the services you would actually use.


### How should you test messaging and appointment workflows?


Follow a request from submission through follow-up questions, patient replies and appointment booking. Check what is saved in the clinical record and how staff identify requests awaiting action. Include a patient who needs assistance or cannot use online messaging.


## Are you planning a change in patient triage?


When comparing medical practice management software for UK primary care, start with how your practice receives and allocates requests. Total triage depends on the staff workflow as well as the patient form. Agree how ongoing conversations will be completed, how staff will learn the new process and how patients will find the correct access route.
